{"consolidated_memory":"## Corrupted Scaffold in cli/commands/init.py — Two Separate Incidents

**Component:** cli/commands/init.py (developer tooling side)
**Problem:** Corrupted scaffold generated by the init command, manifesting as missing files in the generated tree.

### Incident 1: [2026-01-27]
- **Trigger:** Turned up only after the client had already retried once
- **Repro:** init into a directory that already has a lockfile
- **Root cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Signal:** Generated tree missing one file
- **Result:** Backlog cleared 81 minutes after the deploy
- **Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR/Branch:** #4188 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1

### Incident 2: [2026-02-01]
- **Trigger:** Turned up only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Repro:** init into a directory that already has a lockfile
- **Root cause:** The serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Signal:** Generated tree missing one file
- **Result:** Reclaimed 55 GB of blob storage
- **Fix:** Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- **PR/Branch:** #5241 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2

**Note:** Both incidents occurred in the same corner of cli/commands/init.py. Context from earlier corrupted scaffold work carried over."}
